column1: # console-oracle cases: libSceAgc packet-size queries (sceAgc*GetSize). Pure functions: they build nothing and
# touch no GPU state. The size is an ABI fact (a guest reserves command-buffer space from it, see
# docs/gpu/AGC_PACKET_SIZES.md), so every answer is compared. A second case passes a dword count to the
# queries whose size may depend on it.
